Company Description:
Our mission is to turn donations into jobs – offering lifetime purpose and opportunity.

Everyone has the opportunity to discover their full potential and purpose, empowering them to reach financial independence and become productive members of our community.

“Good-Will” Missions of Oakland was started in Oakland’s red-light district in October of 1919 by Reverend Samual Quickmire, his wife Edith, and Methodist Episcopal Church Board of Home Missions. We opened the doors of our first store in 1920 after the San Francisco earthquake. The goods sold were in such high demand that by the end of the year we'd expanded to two more locations. The headquarters moved to Oakland’s Fruitvale district of Oakland in 1956. In 1971, we were renamed Goodwill Industries of the Greater East Bay, and encompassed Alameda, Contra Costa, and Solano Counties.

Today, Goodwill Industries of the Greater East Bay boasts 28 stores, three warehouses, seven job placement centers, e-commerce, and a college.

Goodwill Industries of the Greater East Bay provides workforce development services, including transitional employment, job readiness training, and placement services to people facing barriers to employment in the counties we serve.

Many Goodwill participants face multiple challenges such as a lack of work history, limited education and language skills, a history of incarceration, multi-generational poverty, chronic homelessness, and disabilities.

Company Description:
ESAP LTD. (Employee Screening through Accurate Profiling) has developed a pre-employment test used by hundreds of companies in their hiring process. The applicant's movements are recorded. A combination of shapes, numbers and words. 
There is no way to manipulate the outcome to the applicant's advantage. 
The result is a very powerful foundation of information revealing a clear picture of the unvarnished character, aptitude and behaviors of the applicant. 

It only takes 20 minutes to complete and test results are provided the next business day.

A Custom Target Profile is created for each position and provides a template for hiring success designed for your organization based on the characteristics of "high performance employees"​. 

Interested companies can use the ESAP testing process for free with no obligation while they evaluate.

Company Description:
As your Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) partner, Hueman puts the power of recruitment back in your hands.

When it comes to recruiting and retaining new hires who truly fit your culture, we have the Hueman touch, putting people first in everything we do.

What We Do

As your Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) partner, Hueman helps you get a hold on your recruitment so you can attract and retain top talent. We know exactly what it takes to recruit and retain new hires who truly fit your culture. For us, it all starts by putting people first in everything we do. 

Who We Work With

Our team’s recruitment approach is effective for all position types, across all industries. We recruit for any positions throughout our partners’ organizations, regardless of department or seniority.

Why We’re Good At It

Thanks to a mix of our professionally trained recruiters, culture-based processes and the latest in recruiting technology, our RPO team gets the results you’re looking for: faster starts and higher employee retention, plus decreased premium labor spend. 

Long-Term

1) Enterprise RPO: With this fully integrated recruitment model, we function as your complete hiring department.

2) Permanent Recruiter: Our recruiters become yours, working with specific departments, divisions or openings for longer-term needs.

3) Permanent Sourcer: Our recruiters act as a sourcing tool or service for your team, working with one recruiter, multiple recruiters or an entire department.

Short-Term

1) Project Based RPO: We offer recruitment services for less than one year and/or for a specific department or for specific openings.

2) Sourcing-Only Program: Utilize our sourcing services to funnel candidate leads to your internal HR department or hiring managers for less than one year.

3) Project-Based Permanent Recruiter: Our recruiter partners with your team to help you hire for specific positions for a particular period of time.
